description: Defines the TestCookieAccessDelegate class used for testing cookie access semantics, including setting expectations for cookie domains, handling first-party sets, and callback behavior.

classes.name: TestCookieAccessDelegate
classes.description: A test implementation of CookieAccessDelegate allowing setting expectations and behaviors for cookie access semantics, first-party sets, and callback handling.

methods.name: GetAccessSemantics
methods.description: Returns the access semantics for a given cookie.

methods.name: ShouldIgnoreSameSiteRestrictions
methods.description: Determines if SameSite restrictions should be ignored for a URL and site context.

methods.name: ComputeFirstPartySetMetadataMaybeAsync
methods.description: Computes first-party set metadata asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: FindFirstPartySetEntries
methods.description: Finds first-party set entries for a set of sites.

methods.name: SetExpectationForCookieDomain
methods.description: Sets expected access semantics for cookies matching a domain.

methods.name: SetIgnoreSameSiteRestrictionsScheme
methods.description: Configures schemes that always attach SameSite cookies.

methods.name: SetFirstPartySets
methods.description: Sets the first-party sets for testing.

methods.name: set_invoke_callbacks_asynchronously
methods.description: Configures whether callbacks are invoked asynchronously.

methods.name: FindFirstPartySetEntry
methods.description: Finds a first-party set entry for a specific site.

methods.name: GetKeyForDomainValue
methods.description: Removes leading dot from domain string for keying.

methods.name: RunMaybeAsync
methods.description: Executes a callback asynchronously or returns a result synchronously.
